core: The first move sets momentum—act small, test reality.
power: You likely have less leverage than you think; avoid declarations.
timing: Too early for commitment; gather signal.

core: Build footing—support systems, allies, and constraints.
power: Find the true holder of approval/resources.
risk: Stability risk decreases if you formalize roles/terms.
timing: Good for preparation and quiet alignment.
bias: Desire to ‘prove yourself’ can distort choices.

core: Contact with resistance—overreach creates avoidable damage.
power: Power struggle likely; don’t fight on their terrain.
risk: Escalation risk; reduce surface area of conflict.
timing: Pause before the big step; renegotiate approach.

core: Crossing a threshold—shift from internal prep to external execution.
power: Influence grows through credibility, not force.
risk: Miscommunication risk; clarify intent and boundaries.
timing: Move if conditions are verified; otherwise refine plan.
bias: Confirmation bias: seeing only supporting evidence.

core: Optimal leverage—lead with fairness, clarity, and restraint.
power: You can set terms; use legitimacy, not domination.
risk: Risk is in governance/oversight; keep feedback loops.
timing: Best time for the decisive, well-prepared move.

core: Top of the arc—either completion or overextension; know when to stop.
power: If you push now, you may trigger backlash or loss of trust.
risk: Downside spikes from rigidity; plan an exit/hand-off.
timing: Harvest and conclude; avoid ‘one more push’.
bias: Attachment to outcome/status keeps you trapped.
